name: Generative AI Fundamentals and Prompting
outcome: Use generative AI effectively and critically assess its outputs.
description: Explore how generative models respond to instructions and context. Practise iterative prompting, compare outputs against explicit criteria, and document settings while protecting research data.
external: Basic digital literacy; access to an approved AI tool.
prior: Access to an approved AI assistant
learn: Write clear prompts with context and constraints
Compare and refine responses using explicit criteria
Check claims and record AI use without exposing sensitive data
tools: Approved local or institutional AI chat interface
moduleDescriptions: Explore tokens, context limits, decoding and variability using a short prompt.
Refine task instructions, examples, constraints and output format.
Compare responses with a reference answer and identify unsupported claims.
Record prompt, model and settings; avoid sensitive inputs and disclose use.
prerequisiteRationale: F01 establishes model types, capabilities and limits before learners design prompts.
